description: This file defines utility classes and functions for integrating OpenTelemetry tracing with large language models in the Litellm project. It includes attribute setting for spans, handling message and response attributes, and managing trace metadata related to language model interactions.

classes.name: ArizeOTELAttributes
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes that provides static methods to set OpenTelemetry span attributes related to LLM message exchanges and responses for Arize tracing.

methods.name: set_messages(span: "Span", kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sets span attributes for input messages, including roles and content, for the last message and per-message details.

methods.name: set_response_output_messages(span: "Span", response_obj)
methods.description: Sets span attributes for responses and choices from the LLM, including role and content.

methods.name: _set_tool_attributes(span: "Span", optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Helper to set tool and function call attributes on the span.

methods.name: _set_response_attributes(span: "Span", response_obj)
methods.description: Helper to set attributes related to response content and token usage.

methods.name: set_attributes( span: "Span", kwargs, response_obj, attributes: Type[BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes] )
methods.description: Main function to populate the span with various attributes such as model info, request type, metadata, and response details.
